title: AI tools that work with your files (English voice trial)

teacher.say: Today: install an AI tool that works with files
teacher.line: Today we'll install an AI tool that can work with your files, and learn how to safely allow and deny what it does.

steps.card: 會操作檔案的 AI 工具
steps.eyebrow: 起步 · 第 0 課 · 影片 1
steps.sub: 認識工具、安裝登入、準備練習資料夾，再讓 AI 建立第一個檔案
steps.narration: In this lesson we'll do four things: see what this kind of AI tool can do with your files, install it and sign in, create a folder just for it to practice in, and finally have it create its first file in that folder — and practice saying no.

steps.sub: 例如看看資料夾裡有哪些檔案、讀完一份會議記錄
steps.chapter: 它能對你的檔案做什麼
steps.narration: These tools can do three things with your files. First, read files on your computer — like checking what's in a folder, or reading through meeting notes.

steps.sub: 例如把整理好的重點存成新檔案、修改網頁上的文字
steps.narration: Second, create and edit files — like saving a summary as a new file, or changing the text on a web page.

steps.sub: 例如用瀏覽器打開網頁、搬移或刪除檔案
steps.narration: Third, run commands on your computer — like opening a web page in your browser, or moving and deleting files.

steps.card: 它會直接改動你電腦上的檔案
steps.eyebrow: 和網頁聊天工具最大的差別
steps.sub: 所以它動手前會先問你，我們也會準備一個專用的練習資料夾
steps.narration: The biggest difference from a chat tool on the web is this: it changes the files on your computer directly. That's why it asks you before it acts, and why we'll set up a folder just for it to practice in.

steps.sub: Claude Code · OpenAI Codex CLI · Gemini CLI · Cursor 的 Agent 模式
steps.narration: There are several tools like this — Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and Cursor's Agent mode. Installation and plans differ, so follow the official instructions. This lesson shows one of them; the others work in much the same way.

steps.sub: 只從工具的官方網站或官方擴充功能商店下載；網址見講義
steps.narration: Next, let's install the tool. Only download it from the official website or an official extension store. If you're not sure, check the official link in the handout.
Once it's installed and you've signed in following the prompts, you'll see this screen.

steps.text: 看到自己的帳號，代表已經登入
steps.narration: Your account shows in the sidebar, which means you're signed in.

steps.text: 權限模式選「每次都詢問」（這裡是 Ask permissions）
steps.narration: If the tool lets you choose a permission mode, set it to ask before every action — here it's called Ask permissions. While you're starting out, look at every step yourself before you allow it.

steps.body: 依官方說明安裝工具並登入，確認工具可以啟動、顯示已登入。做完按「完成了，繼續」。

steps.chapter: 建立專用的練習資料夾
steps.narration: Open your Documents folder. This is where your everyday files live, so we won't let the AI practice here.
Create a new folder and name it practice. Use English letters, with no spaces.
Open it — it's empty. From now on, the AI only works inside this folder.

steps.text: 不要把 AI 工具開在桌面、整個使用者資料夾或公司的共用資料夾
steps.narration: Be careful not to open the AI tool on your desktop, your whole user folder, or a shared work folder. And don't put important files in the practice folder.

steps.body: 在「文件」底下新增一個 practice 資料夾，確認裡面是空的。做完按「完成了，繼續」。

steps.narration: The folder is ready. Open the tool from practice, and the current working folder shows at the top of the screen.
steps.chapter: 在練習資料夾開啟工具

steps.text: 先確認：上方的資料夾是 practice
steps.narration: Before we start, take a look at the top. The folder Claude is working in should be practice, the one we just created.
Okay, let's ask it in one sentence to create hello.txt.

steps.say: 好的，我會在目前的資料夾建立 hello.txt。

steps.q: Claude 想要建立這個檔案
steps.preview: 哈囉！這是我在 practice 資料夾裡建立的第一個檔案。
steps.narration: Notice that it didn't just go ahead — it showed a confirmation prompt first.

steps.text: 按下去之前先看三件事：哪個檔案？在哪個資料夾？內容或指令是什麼？
steps.narration: Before you click, check three things: which file it will create, in which folder, and what the content or command is. Only allow it if all three look right.
Everything looks fine this time, so we'll choose Allow once.

steps.say: 已建立 `hello.txt`，裡面是一句問候。

steps.narration: Open Finder and take a look — there really is a new hello.txt in practice. That's the biggest difference from a web chat tool: it changes the files on your computer directly.

steps.body: 在你自己的 practice 資料夾，請 AI 建立 hello.txt。看到確認提示時，先讀清楚「哪個檔案、在哪個資料夾、內容是什麼」再允許。做完按「完成了，繼續」。

steps.narration: Now let's practice saying no. We'll ask it to delete the file we just made.

steps.q: Claude 想要執行這個指令

steps.narration: Hmm… wait — I almost clicked Always allow. Deleting files is something you should always check yourself while you're starting out, so this time we'll choose Deny.

steps.say: 好的，我不會刪除 `hello.txt`。之後需要的話再告訴我。

steps.narration: Back in Finder, hello.txt is still there. When you say no, it doesn't act.

steps.card: 下一課：專案與工作目錄
steps.sub: ✓ 建好 practice　✓ 工具已登入　✓ 允許過一次、拒絕過一次
steps.narration: The tool is installed, the practice folder is ready, and you've allowed once and denied once. In the next lesson, we'll look at where the AI works: projects and the working directory.

voice.style: Warm, friendly American English. Clear and unhurried, like a teacher sitting next to the learner and guiding them step by step.
